notes:
Primary contact: Rahul Mehta (VP Ops).

Context / pain: high-volume e-comm contact center (peak sale events). Heavy chat load: ~6k-10k concurrent chats/hour during promos; currently 22 FTEs on 24/7 triage. Goal: increase automated deflection to 60%+ for common flows and reduce MTTR for escalations. Extremely cost sensitive — deflection unit economics must beat human handling cost.

Technical targets / requirements:
- Workloads: live chat deflection, agent assist (contextual suggestions), ticket summarization, outbound tool-calling (CRM actions).
- Latency: p99 < 200ms for short-turn agent prompts; conversational streaming OK for user-facing flows but backend must keep token cost low.
- Throughput: sustain bursts to ~12k requests/minute for short windows (holiday spikes).
- Deflection target: 60% baseline, 75% stretch in 6 months.
- Cost constraints: TCO model needs per-conversation cost < $0.12 (target) including embedding/rerank passes.
- Model preferences: open to Llama-family quantized variants for cost, must support fast fallback to cheaper variants under load.
- Routing/fallback: want smart routing by cost vs latency; fallback to cached responses for common prefixes.

Security/compliance notes:
- Customer requires SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS keywrap for sensitive metadata, 90-day retention by default, EU-data residency for EU traffic.
- Legal needs SOC2 + pen-test summary before Dedicated or Private procurement.

POC ask (agreed):
- 2-week live traffic-fed POC: ingest 3 days of historical traffic + 48 hours of live shadow traffic. Measure deflection rate, p99 latency, token spend.
- Redwood to provide: batching/caching config, suggested quantization profile, cost projection with unit economics, canary fallback plan.
- Deliverables: POC report (metrics + recommended Dedicated configuration), sample rollback/degard plan, cost sensitivity scenarios.

Quotes / snippets from calls:
- "If we can't hit cost targets we won't be able to scale deflection in peak promos." — Rahul Mehta
- "We need to see consistent p99 numbers during spikes; occasional slowdowns kill agent trust." — Head of Ops
